tijori.business_description: CSM Technologies Ltd. is a Bhubaneswar-based GovTech and digital transformation company specializing in e-governance, AI, cloud, analytics, and enterprise solutions. It serves sectors such as mining, education, healthcare, agriculture, tourism, and public services across India and global markets.
